Elo: ▲/▼ = change since the last tournament. Form: the last 10 games (oldest on the left) – 1 win (gold), 2 2nd (silver), 3 3rd (bronze), 4 4th, = draw. Tier: rank within the budget class – S top 10%, A top 30%, B to 70%, C to 90%, D rest. Games: played, in brackets how many hit Forge's time limit (not scored, replayed) – e.g. 363 (10). Win rate on hover and on the deck page. Card art: © Wizards of the Coast, via Scryfall – hover for the illustrator Sorted by Elo like in chess: every commander starts at 1500. How many points you gain or lose after a game depends on the opponents' Elo – against stronger ones you gain more and lose less, against weaker ones the other way round. That applies to every place: whoever survives longer loses less.

How many points you gain or lose after a game depends on the opponents' Elo – against stronger ones you gain more and lose less, against weaker ones the other way round.
